title: Remember my "what if my drone had weapons?" post? You told me to add multiplayer. I did. It's called Skybreak now 🚁
author: Humble_Bike_7314
selftext:
A few months ago I posted here about a weird idea I had while flying my drone ([original thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1uc32pf/have_you_ever_used_ai_to_create_something_for_you/)). u/recallingmemories said "now add multiplayer support", and I took that personally 😅

It's now Skybreak, a multiplayer drone combat game, and it has its own site with the trailer and news: 👉 [https://drone-dist.fly.dev](https://drone-dist.fly.dev)

What's live: Team Deathmatch over a city with heat-seeking missiles and machine guns, online matchmaking with AI bots filling empty slots, loadouts, and full controller support.

Coming next: Race mode and Destroy the Base.

How it's made with AI. All the code is written with Claude Code in Unity/C#, using the MCP for Unity from the Package Manager. It's still nowhere near "make me a game": I guide it feature by feature and bug by bug. Multiplayer was the hardest part by far. \[one real example here: something it nailed, or something you had to fight it on\] Claude Code also built my launcher, which auto-updates, and the release pipeline that pushes new builds. The 3D art and SFX come from the Unity Asset Store (some free, some paid), and the music is AI-generated with Suno.

**How to get it**: Windows only, Early Access, $4.99 on itch.io: [https://blowback.itch.io/skybreak](https://blowback.itch.io/skybreak). After you buy it, itch emails you a key. Download the launcher from itch, paste in the key, and you're flying. (The key in the screenshot is fake, obviously 😄)

  


https://preview.redd.it/vrgup0es9srh1.png?width=774&format=png&auto=webp&s=8ce1b91b66ae6f81e9a4bddefd4cab0ab711b19b

**Heads up**: it's Early Access, so expect rough edges, and please tell me about them! I'd love feedback and ideas for what should come next.

**A free demo is coming to Steam soon.** The itch version is basically a way to support me so I can keep working on the game 🙏
